title: Threeo
tagline: Create your world, make it your own. Create your own Levels, Scenes, Assets in the 3D Space is Hard. The Concept Ownership increases it even more.
description:
Idea: threeo.surge.sh

Problem: Create your own Levels, Scenes, Assets in the 3D Space is Hard. The Concept Ownership increases it even more.

Solution: Using AI to generate 3D Models. Generate a beautiful scene by typing what you want. Mint the Scene. Throw it in the Realworld via AR. Throw it the Virtual World via VR. Throw it in Decentraland via the Browser. Throw it ... Its yours, do what you feel : )
how_its_made:
Frontend: Javascript (React, R3F, GearJS, Meshy.ai)
SmartContract: Rust (Gear)

The Gear Smart Contract stores a String.
The String holds a link to a 3D File. 
The String can gets reset.
Simplicity first. (Happy about that)

The Frontend takes a prompt.
The Prompt calls Meshy.ai. Meshy.ai generates a 3D Models. The 3D Model get loaded in the Browsers. Another String can insert. Meshy.ai gets called again, another 3D Model get generates. And again. And again. And again. Now we have a fully fledged 3D Scene. Target for non 3D Modeles. 

The Models get placed on the right spot. Scene is finished. Scene gets uploaded, I get a link. 

The Smart Contract gets called and insert the new link. 

Thats an MVP. 

Later on, increase Complexity and utilize to make it available for AR Scene, Construction Scenes, VR Scene, Gaming Scenes and so on.
